title: Account Executive
description:
Manage day-to-day accounting operations, including journal entries, bank reconciliations, voucher entry, bookkeeping, general accounting, ledger maintenance, purchase entry, tax invoices, e-way bills, GST filing, TDS deduction, sales entry, and journal vouchers. 
 Ensure accurate and timely completion of all financial transactions to maintain a healthy cash flow. 
 Prepare monthly MIS reports to track business performance and identify areas for improvement.
